leads.name: The Signal Tree, Cascade Valley Metro Park
leads.reason: Sent by a reader as a tip without a photograph (submission 1115, 2026-11-17), with a pin in the Chuckery Area of Cascade Valley Metro Park. Sources agree: a three-pronged bur oak of some 250 to 350 years, a 1986 plaque linking it to the Portage Trail, cared for by Davey Tree since 2018 (alive, Davey newsroom January 2025). Not shipped because it cannot be visited: Summit Metro Parks has closed the Peck Road entrance and the Chuckery Area since 2023 for the Gorge Dam sediment work, closures expected through at least 2028; the tree is protected behind barriers and stays. Ships the day the area reopens, or sooner if a source or reader shows it can be seen from open public ground.
